text:
The Stars signed Roope Hintz to an eight-year extension on Oct. 30, according to NHL.com. Four days later he had a goal and two assists against Washington. Dallas is betting on the long haul; the early returns say he's still dangerous.

Hintz has six goals and 13 points in 16 games after 44 points in 53 games last season. His speed is back in the conversation: NHL EDGE has his 20 mph bursts in the 98th percentile, and his hardest shot in the 87th. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found that 55% of his shots came off the rush last season, so the first seconds after a Dallas takeaway are when to watch him.

Some of this is hot finishing. He's shooting 21.4%, well above the 11 to 16 we'd expect, and his goals beat his chances by 1.3. His wins added (1.16, 41st in the league) lean on timely goals that may not repeat. Evolving-Hockey had a similar warning about last season. We'd expect fewer goals per shot ahead, but the chances, at 1.06 expected goals per 60, are real.
headline: Hintz signs long, then keeps finishing
